scalars.scalar_value: Must have a minimum of three years (3) experience as a staff technologist with at least one (1) year experience in one specialty field. Will actively work in both Radiology and second specialty.

items.item_text: Must have a minimum of three years (3) experience as a staff technologist with at least one (1) year experience in one specialty field. Will actively work in both Radiology and second specialty.
Transfers and positions patients. Measurement: Observation, Feedback.

Independently perform all diagnostic radiographic imaging and fluoroscopic procedures and specialty procedures of secondary specialty skill according to department protocols keeping with orders from referring physicians, including patient positioning, safe patient handling, and radiographic techniques.
Provides radiation protection in accordance with prescribed safety procedures. Measurement: Observation, Feedback, Departmental monitors.
Accepts responsibility for placing exams in PACS, is able to print images and burn CDs as needed. Measurement: Observation, Feedback, Film accuracy, Film quality.

Identify patients using 2 identifiers, verify physician orders, and explain procedure to patient and obtain consent if needed. Interviews patients for pertinent medical history on patients prior to performing studies.

Uses sterile technique and prevents cross-contamination. Assists in performing of first aid as necessary. Administers and/or assists the physician in administering radiopaque material. Measurement: Observation, Feedback, Departmental monitors.

Ability to function independently in radiology workflows which include RIS/PACS systems, radiographic equipment, as wells as department communication and support systems. Places orders in the HIS/RIS and makes all corrections and cancellation as necessary.

Demonstrates competency and proficiency in patient care for pediatric (neonate as necessary), adult and geriatric patients. Performs scheduling duties, record keeping, patient coordination and prioritization or triage of emergency add-ons.
Required to participate in the department's call schedule to ensure coverage weeknights, weekends and/or holidays on a rotating bases.
Performs role as charge Technologist as needed. Measurement: Observation, Feedback.
